career_ladder.note: Excise Constables and Lady Excise Constables are recruited by the West Bengal Police Recruitment Board (WBPRB) on behalf of the Directorate of Excise under the Department of Finance, Government of West Bengal. Career progression is governed by the Bengal Excise Act, departmental service regulations, and the West Bengal Services (Revision of Pay and Allowances) Rules, 2019 (ROPA 2019).

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to the post of Excise Constable (including Lady Excise Constable) in the Subordinate Excise Service under the Finance Department is conducted by the West Bengal Police Recruitment Board (WBPRB). The examination scheme consists of: (i) Preliminary Written Test (PWT, 100 marks) as a qualifying screening test, (ii) Physical Measurement Test (PMT) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET), (iii) Final Written Test (90 marks), and (iv) Interview (10 marks). Final merit list is compiled on the basis of marks obtained in the Final Written Test and the Interview (Total: 100 marks).

financial_package.note: Excise Constables and Lady Excise Constables in the Subordinate Excise Service are remunerated under Pay Level 6 of the West Bengal Services (Revision of Pay and Allowances) Rules, 2019 (ROPA 2019), corresponding to pre-revised Pay Band-2 (₹5,400 – ₹25,200 with Grade Pay ₹2,600). Entry basic pay is ₹22,700.
financial_package.pay_source_label: WBPRB Information to Applicants for Recruitment to the Post of Excise Constable 2019, and WBS (ROPA) Rules 2019, Level 6
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on ROPA 2019 Level 6 entry basic pay of ₹22,700 with project constant 58% Dearness Allowance (₹13,166), 12% House Rent Allowance (₹2,724), Medical Allowance (₹500/month), plus statutory excise enforcement allowances including ration subsidy and uniform maintenance. Deductions include West Bengal Professional Tax (PTax ₹150–₹200) and GPF/NPS contributions (~10% basic+DA).
official_perks: Government quarters or 12% House Rent Allowance (HRA)
Coverage under the West Bengal Health Scheme (WBHS) for personnel and family dependents
Excise enforcement dietary subsidy and field travel allowances during anti-illicit liquor raids
Annual uniform allowance and kit replacement grant
Special enforcement and preventive duty rewards under excise departmental regulations
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and earned leave encashment under West Bengal Service Rules

competition_benchmarks.note: Excise Constable recruitment is conducted by WBPRB under the Finance Department. Vacancies are verified directly from the official employment notification. Applicant counts are reported from administrative press briefings.

years.selectivity_ratio: approx. 1 in 150 (calculated: reported applicants ÷ notified vacancies)
